def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    barrier = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    cells = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (2, 4)]
    object_row = cells[0][0]
    obj = [(c, v) for r, c, v in cells if r == object_row]
    direction = 1 if object_row > barrier else -1
    target = barrier + direction
    stripe = target + direction
    for r, c, v in cells:
        out[r][c] = 4
    for c, v in obj:
        out[target][c] = v
    if 0 <= stripe < h:
        out[stripe] = [8] * w
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

        stripe = max(rows) + 1 if min(rows) > divider else min(rows) - 1
